investigation_notes.Alert Name: Microsoft Defender: Antivirus Tampering Attempt Prevented
investigation_notes.Description: The alert shows a blocked attempt to stop Microsoft Defender (WinDefend) using sc.exe on WKSTN-FIN-092b, initiated by the service account 'GlobalAdmin_svc'. Remediation succeeded and there were no recent similar alerts or preceding events found on this host in the hour before the attempt. Because the action targeted a security service and was executed by a privileged service account, this activity presents a high risk of defense-evasion and potential compromise and is therefore treated as High Priority.
